consensus_summary: Fans have mixed feelings about the 1966-01-29 show, with some appreciating the historical context and the trippy atmosphere, while others find it lacking in musical substance. The presence of Ken Kesey and the novelty of the acid test format are noted, but many feel it doesn't represent the Grateful Dead's best work.
